minted T3-197 heeding the creator's wishes (trigger parahumans:t08)

T3-197 minted, heeding the creator's wishes (parahumans t08). The author whose serial the ad honours, also a moderator of the room, asks that his name stay off the ad, that he not be pinged and that canvas talk keep to one topic; members relay the wish and comply (removing a ping, moving the talk, making a separate sub). Set against T3-127 (hoping the creators notice the work: gameattack, Summit1G, funhaus and others), which holds fans seeking a creator's regard, not a creator setting limits the fans follow; against T3-128 (relaying a streamer's call to attack); against T3-063 (the sub's own rules). Gate for B1e: members relay or follow the stated wishes of the person or team the work honours (an author, streamer, band or developer) and limit the work accordingly; must not show merely hoping for notice. Kept as a kind of its own under 'when in doubt keep two'. The first new kind since T3-196 (B1b-21), after marker 3.
